page_title: RSO 1-0 MAL | Real Sociedad v Mallorca 21/10/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+6' Javier Aguirre appears to have said too much and referee Jorge Figueroa Vazquez comes over and theatrically shows him a yellow card.
90+5' Samu Costa (Mallorca) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
90+3' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) was quite harsh and Jorge Figueroa Vazquez didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90+3' Hamari Traore (Real Sociedad) is able to continue to play.
90+1' Looks like Hamari Traore (Real Sociedad) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
90' 5 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Mallorca comes to nothing.
86' Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
86' Javier Aguirre has decided to substitute Daniel Rodriguez and he is replaced by Javier Llabres (Mallorca).
84' We are about to witness a substitution. Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad) is replacing Mikel Oyarzabal.
81' The corner is swung in but Real Sociedad can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
77' What a wasted chance that was! A precise cross into the box finds Abdon Prats (Mallorca), whose header flies narrowly wide of the left post.
76' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Mallorca.
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Amath Ndiaye (Mallorca) comes onto the pitch for Antonio Sanchez.
73' Substitution. Cyle Larin walks off the pitch and Abdon Prats (Mallorca) comes on as a substitute.
71' Jon Pacheco (Real Sociedad) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
71' The game has come to an end for Igor Zubeldia. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Robin Le Normand (Real Sociedad).
70' Javier Aguirre decides to make a substitution. Toni Lato will be replaced by Jaume Costa (Mallorca).
69' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Manu Morlanes (Mallorca) is coming onto the pitch as Jose Copete cannot continue after picking up an injury.
69' The referee looks satisfied after his VAR review and duly disallows the goal for offside. The Real Sociedad players look gutted.
68' The Real Sociedad players halt their celebrations as referee Jorge Figueroa Vazquez makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
67' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) receives a killer pass, finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper and coolly sends the ball into the back of the net.
66' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
64' 1 - 0 Goal! Takefusa Kubo swings the ball deep into the box and finds Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) unmarked, and his close-range header flies past the keeper into the roof of the net. 1:0.
62' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
60' Imanol Alguacil has decided to make a change. Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) replaces Carlos Fernandez.
60' A substitution has been made. Aritz Elustondo goes off and Hamari Traore (Real Sociedad) comes on.
57' A cross into the box from Giovanni Alessandro Gonzalez Apud (Mallorca) is cleared.

55' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the bottom left corner, but Alex Remiro thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
51' Aihen Munoz (Real Sociedad) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
49' The defensive wall does its job and blocks the mid-range attempt from the free-kick by Samu Costa (Mallorca).
47' Igor Zubeldia (Real Sociedad) has tested the patience of referee Jorge Figueroa Vazquez and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Arsen Zakharyan comes off for Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad).
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45' We will have 1 min. of added time.
43' It must be a yellow card. It is. Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca) receives the caution after an awful tackle.
41' Toni Lato (Mallorca) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jorge Figueroa Vazquez had an easy-decision to make.
39' Jose Copete (Mallorca) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
37' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Jorge Figueroa Vazquez blows for a foul.
35' The number of shots on goal at present is 2:2.
34' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) clearly handles the ball, but he is surprised when the referee blows his whistle.
31' A quickly taken corner by Mallorca.
28' Carlos Fernandez (Real Sociedad) climbs high to connect with a cross on the edge of the box, but his header is off-target.
26' Real Sociedad have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
25' Giovanni Alessandro Gonzalez Apud (Mallorca) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
23' Igor Zubeldia (Real Sociedad) commits a foul and Jorge Figueroa Vazquez immediately signals a free kick.
21' A weak shot from the edge of the box by Carlos Fernandez (Real Sociedad) is easily saved by Predrag Rajkovic.
18' Giovanni Alessandro Gonzalez Apud (Mallorca) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
16' Carlos Fernandez (Real Sociedad) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
15' The game has begun to heat up. Jose Copete (Mallorca) challenges an opponent and receives a deserved yellow card for his ugly tackle.
13' Mallorca can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

12' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) goes on a mazy run, skips past two defenders and pulls the trigger in front of the keeper. Alex Remiro makes a great save to stop the effort going low into the middle of the goal.
10' Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
7' Samu Costa (Mallorca) makes a strong challenge and Jorge Figueroa Vazquez blows for a foul.
5' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Aihen Munoz (Real Sociedad).
3' The players are on the pitch and Mallorca will have the kick-off.
2' The resulting set piece from Mallorca is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

2' Alex Remiro pulls off a great save to deny Cyle Larin (Mallorca) after receiving a precise defence-splitting pass. The effort is headed for the right side of the goal, but the goalkeeper dives superbly to stop it. Definitely the best save of this match so far!
1' The first half has just begun.
Today's referee will be Jorge Figueroa Vazquez.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
